test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are seven row houses, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, in a campus, but not necessarily in the same sequence. P is not at any of the ends. R is to the immediate right of P. S is third from the left. O is at the left end. M is second from the right. O is not beside N. Where is P located?
solution:
**Seven houses: **M, N, O, P, Q, R, S.

1) S is third from the left. O is at the left end.

2) M is second from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63814b8fd404c96cd7b8e6279f109d92a72f0f04fc3fd59539eeddd5cc28f645.png] 

3) P is not at any end.

4) R is to the immediate right of P.

 
• There is only one consecutive vacant place for P and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f460094ef7bbd4bf2d15034cb064358cda6b1058afc44ea6a84e3e7945d3cdfb.png] 

5) N is not beside O.

 
• The final arrangement will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d299922a39f3ebcafb2bed3871dc6370ad9ea7aa5fe42c2d92c961700e6c43f0.png] 

Thus, **P is located beside S.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Beside S".**
